purpose: Force every addition–multiplication bridge claim to expose scope, information loss, operation laws, exceptional sets, hidden coordinates, and growth assumptions before promotion.

strength_levels.L5_EXACT_INJECTIVE_CONJUGACY: T is injective on the declared domain and both transported operations are exact and reconstructible on the image.
strength_levels.L4_EXACT_HOMOMORPHIC_IMAGE: Both laws descend exactly but T is noninjective; kernel/fibers are part of the result.
strength_levels.L3_FINITE_TYPED_EMBEDDING: Exact only on a declared finite/cell/partial-operation scope; closure and undefined cases are explicit.
strength_levels.L2_LOSSY_INVARIANT: Only selected identities/invariants transport; collisions and missing coordinates are expected and measured.
strength_levels.L1_APPROXIMATE_PROBE: Only approximate/statistical transport is asserted; an error metric and tested regime are mandatory.

sum_product_theorem_gate.rule: No asymptotic growth theorem is applied until ambient ring/field, set size, characteristic/subfield restrictions, injectivity/fiber budget, and theorem status (proved vs conjectural) are recorded.
sum_product_theorem_gate.real_current_note: Near-quadratic real sum-product is not a valid axiom after the 2026 Bloom–Sawin–Schildkraut–Zhelezov counterexample. Use proved lower bounds only.
sum_product_theorem_gate.finite_field_note: Prime-field lower bounds require explicit size hypotheses; dense/full-field or subfield-like regimes are separate.
